inclusion_criteria: BANKS (category 'Bank'): every locally incorporated bank licensed for commercial or retail banking by one of the six GCC central banks (CBUAE, SAMA, QCB, CBK, CBB, CBO) — conventional, Islamic and licensed digital banks — plus GCC-headquartered wholesale/investment banks with a wealth or investment franchise.

Separately licensed banks inside a group (Emirates Islamic, KFH Bahrain) get their own record with parent_id, because they have their own licence, management and customers; their figures are flagged to avoid double counting.

BANK-OWNED INVESTMENT SUBSIDIARIES (category 'Bank-owned investment subsidiary'): in Saudi Arabia, the CMA-licensed capital-market arms of the banks are separate records, because they — not the bank — hold the wealth, brokerage and asset-management licences and would be the contracting party. Elsewhere, bank subsidiaries are captured inside the parent profile; Kamco Invest keeps its own record from the original workbook.

NON-BANKS (category 'Non-bank'): licensed GCC wealth managers, brokerages, asset managers and digital investment platforms that distribute to retail, affluent or HNW clients, or alternatives managers with GCC private-wealth distribution — i.e. plausible ARTA distribution or product partners. Kept in a separate category in every view.

INTERNATIONAL BANKS (category 'International bank (GCC operations)'): only the three foreign banks with large GCC retail/wealth franchises (Standard Chartered — carried over from the original workbook — HSBC and Citi). Profiled at GCC-relevant scope.

EXCLUDED (listed in the coverage register with reason): state development and specialised lenders; foreign bank branches without a material GCC wealth franchise; sovereign wealth funds; insurers, payments, BNPL and crypto-only firms; direct ARTA competitors (wealth-tech vendors); banks absorbed by merger (recorded under the successor).
